translations.web: On the next day, the people rose early and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
translations.bsb: The next day the people got up early, built an altar there, and presented burnt offerings and peace offerings.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
translations.asv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings.
